sayLines.line: Booker is staying at Haven as the camp healer now — tending the sick instead of ranging out.
🎒 A person, maybe 60s shoulders a pack. "Going far this time. Don't wait up."
🧭 Jian is back from past the south (+2280 kcal for the pantry, strange meat (unknown flesh — test it cautiously), 2 stories) (Ask them what they saw.)
📓 Codex: Booker taught Silas Herbal Medicine.

🍖 FEAST 📺 — Sergio opens the pantry wide: 7× Foraged food, 1× Expedition haul (dried). Booker, Ngāwai, Sofia eat until the fire burns low. Somebody laughs so hard they cry. For one evening, nobody is surviving — they're just together. (−1,624 kcal from the pantry) The channeled keepsake feeds the feast — the feast was the weapon, and the surge rides the fire until tomorrow's dawn, spent only when the blades are warmed. (FEAST SURGE ×1.5 armed)
